documents.title: UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED ON 30-09-2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For The Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30-09-2026
Board Meeting Intimation for CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED 30TH SEPTEMBER 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm reported a robust financial performance for fiscal year 2025-2026, with net profit surging 22.60% to 3,188 lakhs and gross sales reaching 34,126 lakhs. Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes, supported by enhanced capacity utilization from new plant and machinery. The company secured an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park where logistics and trading activities have commenced, and placed an order for PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machinery. Management also recommended a dividend of 15% (Rs. 0.15 per equity share) for the financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: The company placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine with advance payment made.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: Management strategically discontinued product lines with sub-optimal margins to focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.
margins_costs.quote: This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in cash profit was primarily due to arranging raw material at cheaper rates without devaluing finished goods prices.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

margins_costs.claim: Production of low-profit finished goods items was stopped to improve performance.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products increased to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved higher capacity utilization through the installation and utilization of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 15% (Rs. 0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/- each) for the financial year 2025-2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.15 per equity share of Rs.1/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2026 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The Board transferred an amount of Rs. 400 Lakh to General Reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the sub-division of existing equity shares from a face value of Rs. 5 per share to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 17th May, 2024 considered and approved the proposal of restructuring the Share Capital of the Company by sub-dividing the existing equity shares into face value of Rs. 1/- per share in place of Rs. 5/- per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company received a notice and a fine of Rs. 50,000 from NSE regarding delay in uploading the Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9).
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) regarding non-compliance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) due to delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Regulations on the NEAPS portal.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in certain periods was attributed to economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to fully switch to sustainable and renewable sources of power such as Solar and PNG energy during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
